title: Loaded High Protein Chicken Bacon Ranch Egg Rolls
description: Delicious, high-protein loaded chicken bacon ranch egg rolls that are perfect for weight loss and muscle gain.
steps: Mix everything together until creamy and fully combined
Add filling to each egg roll wrapper
Air fry at 400 for 10–12 minutes (flip halfway) until golden and crispy
notes:
These egg rolls are perfect for weight loss and muscle gain.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1GMMJnx6tp/

Nutrition: Serving 1 egg roll · Calories 165 · Fat 6g · Saturated fat estimated 2g · Unsaturated fat estimated 4g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol estimated 30mg · Sodium estimated 300mg · Carbs 11g · Fiber estimated 1g · Sugar estimated 2g · Protein 14g

healthy: Rotisserie chicken gives plenty of protein.
Uses light cream cheese and center cut bacon to trim fat.
Cooking spray instead of deep frying.
not_healthy: Ranch packet, hot sauce, bacon and rotisserie chicken make it high in sodium.
Egg roll wrappers are refined flour.
Still has saturated fat from cream cheese and bacon.
